en: Black‑and‑white view of a central town square with unpaved ground in the foreground and rows of old gabled buildings lining the sides. Several houses have arcaded ground floors and dormer windows in steep tiled roofs. A large tree with dense foliage stands near the middle-right, beside a streetlamp. In the background, two church towers with baroque-style domes rise above the roofs. Shop signs in German are visible on the façades, including a corner store and a larger commercial building on the right.
